flavor_text.one_line: Hekana — proselytizing sacerdotal hierocracy of the synthesis; law, piety, tradition.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Hekana are a measured sacerdotal hierocracy people, a first-order synthesis of Aryastan and Kemetra [Peer Synthesis / Theocratic]. They prize law, piety, tradition, lean toward the religious sphere, and field archers, heavy_cavalry, heavy_infantry. Outsiders are met as proselytizing; their patrons touch law.
